## Figure 1: both poles, sea-ice speed and bias
 
![`SeaIce_speed.ipynb`: ACCESS-OM3 MC_100km_jra_iaf+wombatlite-test1-e1de2a94, 1991–2020, versus OSI-455 v1. Rates are geodesic endpoint displacement divided by per-cell sensing duration, not observed instantaneous velocity. Comparison uses full-month model means; intra-month sampling and Lagrangian/Eulerian differences remain. Common model SIC ≥15%, at least 50% of month and 5 accepted observation days per cell. Nominal denotes flag 30. Source: EUMETSAT OSI SAF, doi:10.15770/EUM_SAF_OSI_0012. Issue #51. Common weights for model and observations are cell area × model SIC × month duration. Arctic above, Antarctic below; columns show OBS speed, model speed, paired speed bias and paired direction bias. Speeds are means of monthly-vector magnitudes; arrows are mean east/north vectors sampled every 2 grid cells, with identical scale=2.5 (inverse length). Both poles share speed and zero-symmetric bias scales, using pooled 98th percentiles (minimum ranges 0.03/0.01 m s-1); triangles indicate saturation. Model panels b/f retain SIC-valid model fields independently of local OBS coverage during months with any nominal paired observations in that hemisphere. No extra summer months are added. Speed-bias panels c/g still use the original paired cell-month averages, so they are not a simple subtraction of the separately supported displayed climatologies. Direction panels d/h show SIC × month-duration weighted circular means of local monthly atan2(cross, dot) angles from OBS to model, not angles between climatological vectors. Both speeds must be ≥0.01 m/s; cells with undefined angles or R <0.1 are blank. Positive is counterclockwise (model left); negative is clockwise (model right) in both hemispheres. Direction uses a common ±90-degree colour scale; triangles indicate angles beyond the displayed limits. Annual climatologies use available nominal coverage, not complete 12-month observations. All scalar statistics remain paired and unchanged.](https://ndownloader.figshare.com/files/71381470)

## Both poles: annual velocity and turning sector diagram
 
![`SeaIce_speed.ipynb`: ACCESS-OM3 MC_100km_jra_iaf+wombatlite-test1-e1de2a94, 1991–2020, versus OSI-455 v1. Rates are geodesic endpoint displacement divided by per-cell sensing duration, not observed instantaneous velocity. Comparison uses full-month model means; intra-month sampling and Lagrangian/Eulerian differences remain. Common model SIC ≥15%, at least 50% of month and 5 accepted observation days per cell. Nominal denotes flag 30. Source: EUMETSAT OSI SAF, doi:10.15770/EUM_SAF_OSI_0012. Issue #51. Common weights for model and observations are cell area × model SIC × month duration. Annual climatology pools all available nominal paired cell-months using area × model SIC × month-duration weights. Radius is mean speed in cm/s. The observation arrow is defined at 0 degrees; the model angle is the circular mean of local observation-to-model turning: observation points UP, positive turning LEFT and negative RIGHT. These are relative directions, NOT geographic direction or ice relative to wind. The arrows combine two summary statistics and do not represent a spatially averaged physical velocity vector; their endpoint separation is not vector RMSE. Monthly circular moments retain their resultant lengths when pooled. Angles require both speeds ≥0.01 m/s; model arrows with R <0.1 are hidden. The dashed observation-speed arc separates radial and angular bias. Absolute angular error is annotated to expose cancellation. Summer gaps are not filled: annual means describe available coverage, not an independently observed complete year. Three rows show all paired SIC-valid samples, SIC >80%, and 15% <SIC <80%; columns are Arctic and Antarctic. SIC strata use monthly model SIC after regridding, with identical membership for OBS and model. Subgroup inequalities are strict: exact 80% and 15% are excluded from both subgroups; the original overall result is retained. All six panels share radial and angular scales.](https://ndownloader.figshare.com/files/71381473)

Annual climatology pools all available nominal paired cell-months using area × model SIC × month-duration weights. Radius is mean speed in cm/s. The observation arrow is defined at 0 degrees; the model angle is the circular mean of local observation-to-model turning: observation points UP, positive turning LEFT and negative RIGHT. These are relative directions, NOT geographic direction or ice relative to wind. The arrows combine two summary statistics and do not represent a spatially averaged physical velocity vector; their endpoint separation is not vector RMSE. Monthly circular moments retain their resultant lengths when pooled. Angles require both speeds ≥0.01 m/s; model arrows with R <0.1 are hidden. The dashed observation-speed arc separates radial and angular bias. Absolute angular error is annotated to expose cancellation. Summer gaps are not filled: annual means describe available coverage, not an independently observed complete year. Three rows show all paired SIC-valid samples, SIC >80%, and 15% <SIC <80%; columns are Arctic and Antarctic. SIC strata use monthly model SIC after regridding, with identical membership for OBS and model.
